title: OCaml Temporal native client exact-run signal request
description: Closed JSON document used only by the private Rust client bridge. The request names one exact workflow run, carries a stable signal request ID, and preserves the ordered payload list. Runtime validators also reject duplicate keys, NUL bytes, and identifiers or payload metadata keys over the 65,536-byte safety limit. Payload data follows the start-input bounds: at most 128 MiB per decoded byte field within the 192 MiB document limit.
